rawContent: If you’re interested in supporting someone working hard to expose abuse in the film and TV industry, please support @helenraw  she’s doing amazing things! #noelclarke #MeToo

In light of recent events, is it not time that there was an industry wide code of conduct that all producers and directors were obliged to sign prior to any shooting in the UK? One supported by Equity, Pact, BECTU and BAFTA, maybe even HMRC. 

#MeToo #actors #indiefilm

If the fallout from the horrific #noelclarke case results in more people coming forward to report abuse and a change in the industry mindset on the subject of abuse and bullying, then it will be the silver lining of an otherwise appalling episode. 

@TheWritersGuild #MeToo
